note: Places worth driving to, baked into the build so /places is not served to a crawler as 'The list is on its way'. Refreshed from the panel by scripts/fetch-places.mjs, which keeps this file when the panel cannot be reached. Distances are approximate road distances from Nagercoil, which is where the vehicles are kept -- a straight-line figure is not the number anybody plans a day around.

places.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial
places.blurb: A sacred island monument built where Swami Vivekananda meditated. Reached by ferry from the shore.

places.name: Thiruvalluvar Statue
places.blurb: A 133-foot stone sculpture of the ancient Tamil poet, standing on its own islet beside the rock memorial.

places.name: Triveni Sangamam
places.blurb: The meeting point of the Arabian Sea, the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean.

places.name: Kanyakumari Beach
places.blurb: One of the few places in India where you can watch both sunrise and sunset over the sea.

places.name: Kanyakumari Lighthouse
places.blurb: Wide panoramic views over the coastline and the offshore monuments.

places.name: Kanyakumari Glass Bridge
places.blurb: A recently opened glass walkway over the sea, linking the shore towards the monuments.

places.name: View Tower
places.blurb: A helical pedestrian ramp giving an elevated 360-degree view of the coast.

places.name: Bhagavathy Amman Temple
places.blurb: An ancient seaside temple dedicated to the virgin goddess the town is named after.

places.name: Mahatma Gandhi Mandapam
places.blurb: A pink memorial built on the spot where Gandhi's ashes were kept before immersion.

places.name: Our Lady of Ransom Church
places.blurb: A white Gothic church near the main beach, lit up at night.

places.name: Vattakottai Fort
places.blurb: An 18th-century granite fort on the shore, with ramparts you can walk.

places.name: Suchindram Thanumalayan Temple
places.blurb: Known for its musical pillars and a Hanuman carved from a single rock.

places.name: Padmanabhapuram Palace
places.blurb: A large wooden palace near Thuckalay, famous for its carved ceilings and cool stone floors.

places.name: Thirparappu Waterfalls
places.blurb: A 50-foot waterfall with a bathing pool below, at its best after the rains.

places.name: Mathoor Hanging Bridge
places.blurb: One of the tallest and longest aqueduct bridges in the country, crossing a wooded valley.

places.name: Olakaruvi Waterfalls
places.blurb: A short forest trek to clear hill streams falling over the rocks.

places.name: Kovalam Beach
places.blurb: An arc of golden sand a short drive from town, usually far quieter than the main beach.

places.name: Sanguthurai Beach
places.blurb: A clean, calm beach with white sand, known locally for its kite flying.

places.name: Muttom Beach
places.blurb: Dramatic rocky shore further up the coast, with a historic lighthouse above it.
